posts.title: How I set up macOS for Programming
posts.description: How I set up macOS for Programming Install Homebrew : /bin/bash -c " $( curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh ) " Install these utilities: brew install neovim \ fish \ fnm \ fzf \ fd \ bat \ tokei \ rg \ yazi \ stow \ exiftool \ jq \ gh \ git-lfs \ btop \ ffmpeg-full \ imagemagick \ font-symbols-only-nerd-font \ poppler \ yt-dlp brew install --cask ghostty \

posts.title: Writing Code vs. Writing Prose
posts.description: Writing Code vs. Writing Prose Programming languages were developed because natural language isn’t adequate to communicate instructions to computers. Unlike natural language, programming languages have strong composability: you can take a line of code and start putting things into it or removing things from it to drastically change its meaning.
